topic: Data access for JCD Brazil API
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on whether the JCD Brazil team could extract data from the Beta dataset via the existing API. It was confirmed that the current data-api does not allow changing datasets. However, adding this capability is possible if necessary, requiring a ticket to be created for Anatolii.
decisions: A ticket must be created to enable access to the Beta dataset via the data-api.
action_items: [p1] will create a ticket regarding Beta dataset API access.
